meta.title: TechNova · AI, App & Web Studio in Damascus
meta.description: AI solutions, apps and web experiences for founders and companies, from Damascus, in Arabic and English. This site is our own work: judge us by it.

hero.statement: We build AI solutions, apps and web experiences for founders and companies, from Damascus. This page isn't a brochure about our work: it is our work, built to the standard we ship for clients.

work.title: Built, shipped, running.
work.lead: Five products: a federation's live judging panel, its website and photo store, a telecom portfolio, a boutique's storefront, and our own training platform.

about.statement: We build the software that runs real operations: scoring panels, storefronts, federations. From Damascus, in Arabic and English.

process.title: Brief
process.body: NOVA takes the first pass, then we sit with you and turn the idea into a scope with named screens, rails and rules.

process.title: Build
process.body: We ship in working slices you can open on your phone. Database, interface and admin land together, not as a deck.

process.title: Run
process.body: We host it, watch it and leave you the editing rights, so the product keeps running after the handover.

contact.body: NOVA asks a few sharp questions and turns your idea into a build-ready brief. Every one is read by the team that would build it.
contact.reply: We reply within one working day

nova.name: NOVA
nova.greeting: Hi, I'm NOVA. I turn ideas into build-ready briefs for the TechNova team. What are we making?
